summary: The European Investment Bank filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for the issuance of $4 billion 4.375% notes due 2033. The offering is priced at 99.707% of par, with an underwriting discount of 0.150%, yielding proceeds of approximately $3.982 billion before expenses. Interest is payable semi-annually, and the notes will mature on August 16, 2033. They are unconditional, direct, unsecured general obligations ranking pari passu with other unsubordinated debt. The notes are not redeemable prior to maturity. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation.
